observed_failure.failure_effect: MIM_OPERATOR_STATUS.latest.json drifted to mim-tod-status-dispatch implementation/replan language instead of the lab-awareness runtime objective.

lesson.title: Use objective-shaped runtime prompts for lab-awareness guidance
lesson.rule: When TOD is guiding an active MIM lab-awareness runtime objective, the prompt must use the deterministic objective shape so MIM routes it to mim_lab_awareness_runtime_objective instead of TOD status dispatch, conversation, or bounded implementation replan.
resolution_pattern: Include MIM_LAB_AWARENESS_STATUS or MIM_LAB_SENSOR_INVENTORY artifact names.
Avoid status-check phrasing that asks TOD to inspect or diagnose unless the intended owner is TOD.
After publishing, verify the gateway response has internal_intent=mim_lab_awareness_runtime_objective.

required_next_mim_action: Continue from the recovered lab-awareness route and run/connect the MIM-owned lab sensor inventory executor.
tod_codex_boundary: monitor and guide only; do not implement camera, microphone, TTS, human memory, or object recognition work for MIM
